readings: For each AlbumId group (tracks with a NULL AlbumId form one group), compute the album's rate as the average of the per-track ratios Bytes/Milliseconds. Skip tracks whose Bytes is NULL. The all-album average is the unweighted mean of these album rates across all groups. Return the top 10 groups by (album rate minus all-album average), largest first. Show AlbumId (NULL for the no-album group), the average track UnitPrice, the album rate, and the difference. Don't round.

For each AlbumId group (tracks with a NULL AlbumId form one group), compute the album's rate as SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) over tracks whose Bytes is not NULL. The all-album average is the unweighted mean of these album rates across all groups. Return the top 10 groups by (album rate minus all-album average), largest first. Show AlbumId (NULL for the no-album group), the average track UnitPrice, the album rate, and the difference. Don't round.

For each AlbumId group (tracks with a NULL AlbumId form one group), compute the album's rate as the average of the per-track ratios Bytes/Milliseconds. Skip tracks whose Bytes is NULL. The comparison baseline is the average of Bytes/Milliseconds over all tracks with non-NULL Bytes, with each track weighted equally regardless of album. Return the top 10 groups by (album rate minus baseline), largest first. Show AlbumId (NULL for the no-album group), the average track UnitPrice, the album rate, and the difference. Don't round.

For each AlbumId group (tracks with a NULL AlbumId form one group), compute the album's rate as SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) over tracks whose Bytes is not NULL. The comparison baseline is the overall SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds) across all tracks with non-NULL Bytes. Return the top 10 groups by (album rate minus baseline), largest first. Show AlbumId (NULL for the no-album group), the average track UnitPrice, the album rate, and the difference. Don't round.
queries:
WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price,
         AVG(CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds) AS album_rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT AlbumId,
       avg_price,
       album_rate,
       album_rate - (SELECT AVG(album_rate) FROM album_rates) AS difference
FROM album_rates
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH album_rates AS (
  SELECT AlbumId,
         AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price,
         CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS rate
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY AlbumId
)
SELECT AlbumId,
       avg_price,
       rate,
       rate - (SELECT AVG(rate) FROM album_rates) AS diff
FROM album_rates
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH t AS (
  SELECT AlbumId, UnitPrice, CAST(Bytes AS REAL) / Milliseconds AS ratio
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
),
base AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS b FROM t
)
SELECT AlbumId,
       AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
       AVG(ratio) AS album_rate,
       AVG(ratio) - (SELECT b FROM base) AS difference
FROM t
GROUP BY AlbumId
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
SELECT AlbumId,
       AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
       CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) AS album_rate,
       CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(Milliseconds) FROM Track WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL) AS diff
FROM Track
WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY AlbumId
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
